ICS 61.060; 97.180

CHD 23

1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for brushes, shoe polishing.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of and necessary adjuncts to this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid. All standards are subject to revision and parties to agreements bases on this standard are encouraged to investigate the possibility of applying the most recent editions of these standards.
